# Barlow

The typeface of Loadout Bay's screen. `ps2/tools/bake_font.py` renders it into the glyph atlas in `ps2/src/font_data.c`; the font files it reads are in `ps2/assets/fonts`.

- Source: [google/fonts](https://github.com/google/fonts) `ofl/barlow` and `ofl/barlowcondensed` (Barlow 1.408, by Jeremy Tribby, [jpt/barlow](https://github.com/jpt/barlow)), fetched 2026-10-30.
- Files: `Barlow-SemiBold.ttf`, `Barlow-Bold.ttf`, `BarlowCondensed-SemiBold.ttf`, `BarlowCondensed-Bold.ttf`, unchanged. `Barlow-Medium.ttf` (same source and version) is for the desktop app only and lives in `src/Loadout.App/Assets/Fonts`.
- Licence: SIL Open Font License 1.1, in `OFL.txt`.
